title: I asked my AI to show the first week of progress on my game
author: Lemon30
selftext:
Hey everyone!

Full disclosure, the game and the video are all made by AI, but it's me writing the post.

  
I have been working on this game for the past 10 days or so. I started at the library's cafe on a cold afternoon after seeing the gameplay of the new warhammer survivors game and my weekly reset was coming up.

So I started Codex, asked it to install godot and blender and get the first prototype running. I spent the first few days with Sol 6.1 medium/high and switched to Sol 6.2 as it was just rolled out soon after.

  
My workflow is asking gpt to generate some mockup images on how the game would look like. Sometimes I'd even draw on paper and give a photo to explain things like menus and models. I also found myself asking about other similar games and their screenshots. Then I feed the image back and ask it to follow our art direction. And iterate and iterate.

  
I also had a reset coming up so I started using Astra Max for a day or two. I believe the difference is insane. Most times, you can pretty much explain once and Astra Max would take care of whereas Sol High or Astra Medium would stop early or mess things up.

  
I have been seeing some awesome work here and on twitter in especially the past couple of months. Hence, I wanted to give gamedev another try. I guess Opus 5.5 is a beast, but I'm yet to try it. I'm super happy with how things are going on week 1. I hope I will stick with the project.

I'd also love to hear some feedback, if you'd like to give the game a try at: [https://lemon30.itch.io/pikebound](https://lemon30.itch.io/pikebound)

Let me know if you have any questions.

On a side note, I'm also asking GPT to do some social media. I've been pumping videos with Astra, Remotion plugin, Elevenlabs for tts and sfx. That's another experiment I'm running, eventhough the videos obviously look and sound AI. You can check it out at: [https://www.youtube.com/@Pikebound](https://www.youtube.com/@Pikebound)

Thanks!

comments.author: redline_hockey
comments.body: That's cool! I'm curious on how long it would take Claude would show the progression for my project that has 300+ hours. Thanks for the idea.

replies.author: Lemon30
replies.body:
Thanks! I was asking GPT to output videos a lot to show me the end result. I mostly develop from the mobile app with a remote connection. I believe it stitched those together.

But I'm sure even without those Claude can do a nice job. It might just cost a bit of your quota.
